about.title: About me
about.subtitle: I work remotely for Portugal's Ministry of Health, from Montenegro, RS.
about.p1: I started as a junior developer in 2020 and within four years I took on the technical leadership of a European public healthcare ecosystem. That progression came from focusing on what matters most: solid architecture, code that works in production, and teams with clear direction.
about.p2: At SPMS, I lead 4 developers and I'm responsible for the ELO/PACI architecture — Hexagonal, DDD, BFF, OIDC. I also integrated AI agents into the development cycle to improve code quality and test coverage.
about.p3: I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and Development from UNISC and I'm pursuing a postgraduate degree in Artificial Intelligence. I'm looking for international remote opportunities where I can have significant technical impact.
